text_block_list.text:
Hey, got a second?
There's a favor I'd like to ask.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Hm? Laurel?
What's up, I wonder—)

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
A favor...?
Um, what kind?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Well, the Miho Dorm social gathering is coming up soon, right?
We're playing games and putting on performances.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
We were planning to do a stage play, but...
the girl who was supposed to perform with us
suddenly won't be able to make it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So we're looking for someone to fill in.
Would you be interested in performing with us?

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
A-A stand-in?
Hmm, I don't know if I can do it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Just take a look at the script first!
It's this role on page one—

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Let's see... Wait, WHAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this the opening scene?!
And completely alone on stage, all by myself...?!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't! That's way too huge of a responsibility!
My mind would just go completely blank...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, it was sudden of me to ask.
Thanks for hearing me out though!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Laurel! That means it's the role
that charges out onto the stage first, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Nice, sounds thrilling.
That stand-in—I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: E-Eeehh...?!

text_block_list.name: MC Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Performed by Sakura Laurel and company,
the original play "Prince of Ciel"! It's showtime~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I swear to you. I will undoubtedly—
become the king of this land.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No matter how young I may be, it matters not.
That is no excuse to give up.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
A great feat that no one has ever achieved—
I will be the one to accomplish it!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-san! The play was incredible~!
To think you stood in last minute and gave
such a commanding performance...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Because I had absolute faith
that I could pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
And once you believe that...
there's only one thing left to do, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Charge in with the pure determination to see it through!
No matter how daunting the obstacle.

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! I wish I took the part too~!
Seeing how much you moved everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, I spotted the two horse girls
who had been the talk of the dorm gathering.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, it was all thanks to you, Bubble-chan!
...Fufu, I can't let myself lose to you either.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I have to take a bold step forward too.
First off... maybe I'll take on our next race
with full force♪

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Oho...! That's what I like to hear, Laurel!
choice_data_list: You two really push each other to greater heights!
You two really push each other to greater heights!
Your influence might make more girls take the initiative.
Your influence might make more girls take the initiative.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Oho...! That's what I like to hear, Laurel!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That might be true! If I take the lead and charge ahead,
my rivals will bite back with everything they've got.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who fired Laurel up, after all.
I'll take on her challenge fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm honored!
To think watching me could fire everyone up like that.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm not handing over the title of vanguard.
The one who dives headfirst before anyone else will always be me!
